### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

This repository contains the source code for CleverHans, a Python library to benchmark machine learning systems' vulnerability to [adversarial examples](http://karpathy.github.io/2015/03/30/breaking-convnets/). You can learn more about such vulnerabilities on the accompanying [blog](http://cleverhans.io). The CleverHans library is under continual development, always welcoming of the latest attacks and defenses. In particular, we always welcome help towards resolving the [issues](https://github.com/cleverhans-lab/cleverhans/issues) currently open.
